judgments.reason: The span 'Revealed mild aortic regurgitation of the bicuspid aortic valve' appears literally in the transthoracic echocardiography findings and directly supports including both 'mild aortic regurgitation' and 'bicuspid aortic valve' in the completed diagnosis label.

The span 'Revealed ascending aortic aneurysm with diameters of ascending aorta and sinus of Valsalva at 49mm and 40mm respectively' appears literally in the CT angiography findings and directly supports including 'ascending aortic aneurysm' in the completed diagnosis label.
